_comment: THE HEARTBEAT config (canon, committed). One sensory pass, fixed order — the four signal agents + capture pull + a timeaudit pulse + the two witnesses added 30 Jul 2026 (capsule_bridge = what the locked capsules already know; shipped = artifacts produced, the second witness beside the time camera). Shelled in sequence, each isolated; one failure never aborts the beat. heartbeat.mjs writes pulse.json only; every agent keeps sole ownership of its own file. Order matters: capsule_bridge runs AFTER fsrs so it can name where the two schedulers disagree.
